FROM node:24.20.0-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /src
RUN corepack enable
COPY package.json pnpm-lock.yaml pnpm-workspace.yaml ./
COPY ji-java/web/app/package.json ji-java/web/app/package.json
RUN corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
COPY contracts/generated/relay contracts/generated/relay
COPY contracts/generated/hcp contracts/generated/hcp
COPY ji-java/web/app ji-java/web/app
RUN corepack pnpm --filter @ji/web-app build

FROM nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged:1.29.3-alpine
COPY --from=build /src/ji-java/web/app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
COPY deploy/relay/nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
USER 101:101
